harmonization_roadmap.reference_standard: Aqua MODIS during valid overlap periods (2012â2024)
harmonization_roadmap.approach: Monthly geographic tile-level calibration using robust median ratios and calibration percentiles. No synthetic scaling factors are applied until empirical leave-one-year-out validation is completed.
harmonization_roadmap.current_phase: Phase 1: Multi-sensor raw aggregation with explicit provenance and uncertainty tracking.
harmonization_roadmap.next_phase: Phase 2: Leave-one-year-out empirical calibration and forward temporal validation.

scientific_caveats: Hotspot detections are satellite pixels with thermal anomalies; they are not confirmed fire events or burned area.
Detection is subject to cloud obscuration, dense canopy cover, and orbital viewing geometry.
A missing observation date indicates a satellite data gap and must not be interpreted as zero fire activity.
More detections from VIIRS do not necessarily mean more fires due to its 375m pixel sensitivity.
